pricing.title: One TV free. Pay monthly when you need more.
pricing.body: Free for 1 TV. 3 screens at $3 a month. Many screens at $5. Pay by Vietnam bank transfer or Stripe card.
pricing.freePairing: Try one screen. Pair with a PIN. No expiry.
pricing.freeNote: Enough for one desk or one room. Upgrade when you add TVs.
pricing.threePairing: Lobby and a few rooms. Pair with the PIN on the TV.
pricing.threeNote: Pay by bank transfer or Stripe. TVs stop when the month ends.
pricing.manyPairing: No screen cap. Pair with a link. No PIN to type.
pricing.manyNote: Same MP4 or YouTube backgrounds. No TV limit.

items.q: How is SignageHub different from ad screens?
items.a: This is a per-room, per-guest welcome. Front desk checks in on the CMS and the room TV updates the name and template at once. No slide playlist.

items.q: What if one room has several TVs?
items.a: Every TV paired to that room shows the same content: guest name, Wi-Fi, weather, background. Change the room on the CMS once.

items.q: Where do photos and video live?
items.a: The hotel default is on the Hotel page. Each room can set its own: image, MP4/WebM, or a YouTube/Vimeo link.
Six presets: Golden night, Soft morning, Harbor night, Tea garden, Warm stone, Vista. Managers enable or hide them and set a default. Front desk picks at check-in.

items.q: How long does TV pairing take?
items.a: On the 3-screen plan the TV shows a PIN and the desk types it into the room. On many screens the desk copies a link and the TV opens it. No code to type.
1 TV is free. 3 screens at $3 a month. Many screens at $5. The Vietnamese site shows 15,000 dong and 50,000 dong for the paid plans.
The join form emails a hotel-manager account to the address you enter. Front desk staff are added later by that manager.
Email nguyenduy0170@gmail.com. That is the SignageHub support inbox.
